name: Synology NAS
summary: Synology NAS 檔案操作與連線看板
description:
Synology NAS 檔案操作與連線看板
收集方式：Syslog UDP。這個套件不會建立 Input，請自行建立並把來源指向它。
★ 安裝後必做：把管線接到存放這類記錄的串流。沒有接串流的管線不會處理任何記錄。全新安裝的 Graylog 7 預設先執行管線、後分配串流，這時接在自建串流上的管線不會運作：請到 System → Configurations → Message Processors，把 Stream Rule Processor 移到 Pipeline Processor 前面。
告警預設不掛通知，事件只會寫進 Graylog；需要通知請自行加上。
★ 請只把管線接到「只含這種設備記錄」的串流。synology-00-gate 只認領其他套件沒認領的記錄，並寫入 parsed_by=synology；其他套件已認領的記錄不會再處理。

source.@value:
rule "synology-10-fs-event"
when
    has_field("message") && contains(to_string($message.message), "FileStation Event:")
then
    set_fields(grok(pattern: "FileStation Event: %{WORD:fs_event},", value: to_string($message.message), only_named_captures: true));
end

rule "synology-10-fs-path"
when
    has_field("message") && contains(to_string($message.message), "Path:")
then
    set_fields(grok(pattern: "Path: %{DATA:fs_path},", value: to_string($message.message), only_named_captures: true));
end

rule "synology-10-fs-size"
when
    has_field("message") && contains(to_string($message.message), "Size: ")
then
    set_fields(grok(pattern: "Size: %{DATA:fs_size},", value: to_string($message.message), only_named_captures: true));
end

rule "synology-10-fs-user"
when
    has_field("message") && contains(to_string($message.message), "User: ")
then
    set_fields(grok(pattern: "User: %{DATA:fs_user},", value: to_string($message.message), only_named_captures: true));
end

rule "synology-10-fs-ip"
when
    has_field("message") && contains(to_string($message.message), "IP: ")
then
    set_fields(grok(pattern: "IP: %{IPV4:fs_ip}", value: to_string($message.message), only_named_captures: true));
end

rule "synology-10-fs-type"
when
    has_field("message") && contains(to_string($message.message), "File/Folder: ")
then
    set_fields(grok(pattern: "File/Folder: %{DATA:fs_type},", value: to_string($message.message), only_named_captures: true));
end

rule "synology-10-fs-action"
when
    has_field("message") && contains(to_string($message.message), "Event: ")
then
    set_fields(grok(pattern: "Event: %{DATA:fs_action},", value: to_string($message.message), only_named_captures: true));
end

rule "synology-10-conn-user"
when
    has_field("message") && contains(to_string($message.message), "User [")
then
    set_fields(grok(pattern: "User \\[%{DATA:conn_user}\\]", value: to_string($message.message), only_named_captures: true));
end

rule "synology-10-conn-from"
when
    has_field("message") && contains(to_string($message.message), "from [")
then
    set_fields(grok(pattern: "from \\[%{DATA:conn_from}\\]", value: to_string($message.message), only_named_captures: true));
end

rule "synology-10-conn-proto"
when
    has_field("message") && contains(to_string($message.message), "via [")
then
    set_fields(grok(pattern: "via \\[%{DATA:conn_proto}\\]", value: to_string($message.message), only_named_captures: true));
end

rule "synology-10-conn-folder"
when
    has_field("message") && contains(to_string($message.message), "folder [")
then
    set_fields(grok(pattern: "folder \\[%{DATA:conn_folder}\\]", value: to_string($message.message), only_named_captures: true));
end

rule "synology-10-nas-app"
when
    has_field("message") && regex(" .* Event: ", to_string($message.message)).matches == true
then
    set_fields(grok(pattern: " %{DATA:nas_app} Event: ", value: to_string($message.message), only_named_captures: true));
end

rule "synology-10-nas-app-2"
when
    has_field("message") && contains(to_string($message.message), "via")
then
    set_fields(grok(pattern: " %{DATA:nas_app}: .* via \\[", value: to_string($message.message), only_named_captures: true));
end

rule "synology-10-conn-signinto"
when
    has_field("message") && contains(to_string($message.message), "sign in to")
then
    set_fields(grok(pattern: "sign in to \\[%{DATA:conn_signinto}\\]", value: to_string($message.message), only_named_captures: true));
end

rule "synology-10-conn-signinto2"
when
    has_field("message") && contains(to_string($message.message), "signed in to")
then
    set_fields(grok(pattern: "signed in to \\[%{DATA:conn_signinto}\\]", value: to_string($message.message), only_named_captures: true));
end

pipeline "Synology NAS - parse"
stage -24 match either
rule "synology-00-gate"
stage 0 match either
rule "synology-00-passthrough"
rule "synology-10-fs-event"
rule "synology-10-fs-path"
rule "synology-10-fs-size"
rule "synology-10-fs-user"
rule "synology-10-fs-ip"
rule "synology-10-fs-type"
rule "synology-10-fs-action"
rule "synology-10-conn-user"
rule "synology-10-conn-from"
rule "synology-10-conn-proto"
rule "synology-10-conn-folder"
rule "synology-10-nas-app"
rule "synology-10-nas-app-2"
rule "synology-10-conn-signinto"
rule "synology-10-conn-signinto2"
end

Claims what no other pack claimed (parsed_by): connect this pipeline to a stream of this device only.

source.@value:
rule "synology-00-gate"
when
    !has_field("parsed_by") OR
    to_string($message.parsed_by) == "synology"
then
    set_field("parsed_by", "synology");
end
